## Handover notes

- `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: - The partial handover is the product of a cancel: `completed`, `remaining` and `verification: partial` must be honest.
- `swarm-dod-evidence`: - Hand over the criteria with their status so the reviewer can re-run `shared_dod_check` on the same evidence.
- `swarm-escalation-takeover`: - Hand the decision, the attempts already made and the unresolved questions to the executing agent (see step 8).
- `swarm-handover-emit`: - This skill produces the handover; the receiver runs `swarm-handover-intake` against it.
- `swarm-handover-intake`: - The receipt is the acknowledgement. Carry unresolved `questions` forward in your own handover (`swarm-handover-emit`), filed under your own task id.
- `swarm-lease-discipline`: - Name any file you edited under an unclear lease state in the handover's `blockers` or `constraints`, so the receiver verifies it.
- `swarm-open-questions`: - Carry unresolved and assumed items in `open_questions` of your handover, assumptions marked as assumptions.
- `swarm-provenance-trust`: - Pass trust levels along: list unverified inputs under `open_questions` and faulty ones under `blockers`.
- `swarm-rework-intake`: - Hand the fixed artifacts, the finding ids addressed and the decisions to the gate agent that issued the verdict.
- `swarm-scratchpad-protocol`: - Name the keys you wrote and why in the handover `constraints` or `open_questions`, so the receiver reads them.
- `swarm-self-verify`: - Hand over the checklist outcome and any unverified item as `verification` and `open_questions` (`swarm-handover-emit`).
- `swarm-status-reporting`: - The final status text is not a handover; put durable facts in the handover (`swarm-handover-emit`).
